output.summary: KEP-2305 proposes dynamically configuring an allowlist of label values for a metric at runtime, so that a metric dimension can be bound to a known set of values without coupling that change to a Kubernetes code release. The status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: Metrics with unbounded label dimensions can cause memory problems in the components that expose them. Past fixes required re-releasing the binary: deleting labels or metrics, or retroactively adding accepted value sets. The KEP aims to bind a metric dimension to a known set of values that is not tied to code releases, with the allowlist supplied through a new component metric flag.

alternatives.option: Manually track all values a label can take while adding a new label, with rigorous PR review
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this approach is manual and error prone.

evidence.quote: we want to be able to *dynamically configure* an allowlist of label values for a metric *at runtime*.
Fixing these issues is currently a manual process, both laborious and time-consuming. We don't have a standard prescription for resolving this class of issue.
The allowlist will be ingested via a new-added component metric flag.
But this approach is manual and error prone.
